matches.title: Multiple GCP products are experiencing Service issues
matches.summary: A policy with blank fields replicated globally within seconds and hit new, unflagged Service Control code without error handling, which crashed in a loop. A kill switch disabled the path quickly, but restarting tasks without randomized backoff overloaded the Spanner backend in a large region, stretching recovery there by hours.

matches.title: Summary of the AWS Service Event in the Northern Virginia (US-EAST-1) Region
matches.summary: An automated scaling activity triggered a surge of connections from internal clients that overwhelmed the devices between AWS's internal and main networks. A latent bug stopped those clients from backing off, so retries kept the congestion going. AWS stopped the scaling, rerouted internal DNS traffic, added capacity and fixed the back-off.

props.title: Why are SMS retries capped?
props.text: [2025-12-30 18:26] Maya Okoro: Post-incident question: why did notifications hammer the SMS provider? [2025-12-30 18:28] Owen Bryce: Every provider timeout triggered an immediate retry, forever. The provider throttled our whole account. [2025-12-30 18:30] Owen Bryce: Decision: SMS retries stay capped at 3 attempts with exponential backoff; more than that floods the provider and gets us throttled.…

props.title: notifications README
props.text: # notifications Sends appointment reminders and result alerts. SMS goes through sms-gateway; email through the mail provider. Owner: Owen Bryce. Retries: at most 3 SMS attempts with exponential backoff (see #platform).

props.title: Postmortem: SMS provider throttled our account
props.text: Unbounded retries in notifications v3.1.0 flooded the SMS provider, which throttled the account for 3 hours. Appointment reminders stopped. Resolution: restored the 3-attempt cap with backoff and drained the retry queue.

props.title: Postmortem: results page timeouts
props.text: After the records migration, lab-results scanned records-db without the visit_id index and the portal results page timed out. Resolution: added the missing index on visit_id and re-ran the report backfill.

props.title: Summary of the AWS Service Event in the Northern Virginia (US-EAST-1) Region
props.summary: An automated scaling activity triggered a surge of connections from internal clients that overwhelmed the devices between AWS's internal and main networks. A latent bug stopped those clients from backing off, so retries kept the congestion going. AWS stopped the scaling, rerouted internal DNS traffic, added capacity and fixed the back-off.

nodes.label: PublicPostmortem
nodes.name: Multiple GCP products are experiencing Service issues

props.title: Multiple GCP products are experiencing Service issues
props.summary: A policy with blank fields replicated globally within seconds and hit new, unflagged Service Control code without error handling, which crashed in a loop. A kill switch disabled the path quickly, but restarting tasks without randomized backoff overloaded the Spanner backend in a large region, stretching recovery there by hours.

props.excerpt: Decision: SMS retries stay capped at 3 attempts with exponential backoff; more than that floods the provider and gets us throttled.
Resolution: restored the 3-attempt cap with backoff and drained the retry queue.
